name: VRSchool Assistente Virtual IA
summary:
VRSchool, a product of Grupo Plan Marketing, introduces an innovative app that takes learning to a new level. Developed to demonstrate the power of Artificial Intelligence in education, the app allows students to interact with an AI Virtual Assistant in augmented reality or text mode, directly during virtual reality lessons.
